1010.description: A straight-leg deadlift with a band, hinging forward at the hips. It trains the lower back and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your feet.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing your body, and keep your arms straight.
Engage your core and maintain a slight bend in your knees.
Slowly hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
Lower the band towards the ground while keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在脚上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝向身体，手臂伸直。
收紧核心并保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
慢慢地以臀部为中心向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将弹力带降低至地面，同时保持双腿伸直。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1074.description: Open your arms wide against the straps. It stretches and works the chest.
instructions: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

1138.description: A push-up with feet in the straps where one knee drives toward the elbow as you lower.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
As you descend, bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.

1202.description: Pressing a cable straight out from your chest while resisting the pull to rotate. It trains anti-rotation core strength.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

1266.description: A one-arm incline cable press on an exercise ball. It trains the upper chest and balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back resting against an incline bench.
Hold a cable handle in one hand and position your arm at a 90-degree angle with your elbow bent.
Press the cable handle forward and upward, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
一只手握住电缆手柄，将手臂呈 90 度角，肘部弯曲。
向前和向上按下电缆手柄，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1330.description: A one-arm row with an underhand grip, supported on an incline bench. It works the upper back and biceps one side at a time.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place a dumbbell on the floor next to the bench.
Stand facing the bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the waist and place your left knee and left hand on the bench for support.
Pick up the dumbbell with your right hand using a reverse grip (palm facing down).
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with your left arm.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将哑铃放在长凳旁边的地板上。
面对长凳站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲腰部，将左膝和左手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
用右手反握（手掌朝下）拿起哑铃。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉。
以受控的方式将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用左臂重复练习。

1394.description: A smith machine calf raise done with the bar in front of you. It targets the calves and the muscles around the shin.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆调整到略低于肩膀的高度。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向前。
将脚掌放在台阶或平台的边缘，脚后跟悬空。
抓住横杆以获得支撑。
尽可能高地抬高脚跟，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1458.description: Seated curls with an EZ bar, which is gentler on the wrists. A good way to build the biceps without swinging your body.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your upper arms on your thighs, allowing the ez barbell to hang down in front of you.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the ez barbell upwards towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the ez barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
将上臂放在大腿上，让 ez 杠铃垂在您面前。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上卷曲至肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将 ez 杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1522.description: A snatch that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive pull and catching the bar overhead.
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a wide snatch grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1586.description: A seated hamstring curl on a machine with one leg at a time. It isolates each hamstring.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and adjust the leg pad above your heel.
Place one leg under the pad and rest the other foot on the footrest.
Curl your heel down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstring at the bottom.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

1650.description: Alternating dumbbell curls seated on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps while the core keeps you upright.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell while rotating your forearm until your palm is facing your shoulder.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the curl with the other arm.
Continue alternating curls for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举一只哑铃，同时旋转前臂，直到手掌面向肩膀。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复弯举动作。
继续交替卷发达到所需的重复次数。

1714.description: A partner-assisted stretch lying face down for the rectus femoris. It lengthens the front of the hip and thigh.
instructions: Lie face down on the ground with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and reach back with your right hand to grab your right foot or ankle.
Gently pull your right foot or ankle towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in the front of your right thigh.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲右膝，用右手向后伸抓住右脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将右脚或脚踝拉向臀部，感受右大腿前部的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开并在另一侧重复。

1778.description: A partner draws your arms back while you stand, opening up your chest. It is a deeper stretch than you can usually reach alone.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides and your hands at shoulder height or slightly lower.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly pull your arms back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1842.description: Stretches the front of the neck by letting the head drop back from the edge of a bench or bed.
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.

1906.description: Lying on your back, you open one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh and groin.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1970.description: A tall standing stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

2098.description: Tilts the hand sideways at the wrist with a straight elbow to stretch the forearm muscles along the outer edge of the arm.
instructions: Stand tall and extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight.
Turn the palm so the thumb points up.
Grab the hand with your other hand and tilt it gently toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow locked and the shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

2162.description: Marching the knees while holding a plank with a band around the legs, which challenges the core and hips together.
instructions: Place a loop band around your thighs or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Return it quietly and lift the other knee.
Keep your hips from rocking side to side.
Alternate for the planned time or reps.

2290.description: A single-leg squat with the back foot raised, building leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

2354.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it just outside your legs.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays neutral and braced from the floor to lockout.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2418.description: A kneeling side kick with a band that targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with a band around your thighs.
Keep your core braced and your back flat.
Lift one bent leg out to the side against the band.
Pause when your thigh is about hip height.
Lower slowly without twisting your torso.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2738.description: A floor version of the lying triceps extension, where the floor limits how far you lower the weight.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop just before the weights touch the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing up.

2802.description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist and hands under the glutes. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your abs and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将双腿拉向对面的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2866.description: A Pilates twist from a side-supported position that trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.

2930.description: A band pull-apart with palms facing up and elbows bent at 90 degrees. It targets the rear delts and external shoulder rotation.
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at chest height with palms up and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides.
Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

2994.description: A foam roller technique for the front of the lower leg that eases tightness.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with the foam roller under your shins.
Support yourself with your hands in front.
Shift your weight to roll along the front of your lower leg.
Move slowly and pause on tight spots.
Roll for 30-60 seconds per leg.

3122.description: A seated shoulder press using a resistance band. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with both hands, palms facing forward, and bring it up to shoulder level.
Press the band overhead, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住阻力带，手掌朝前，将其拉至肩部水平。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带降低至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

3186.description: An overhead press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The unstable load trains control in the shoulders.
instructions: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Use a lighter load and keep the bar steady.

3250.description: A standing toe touch with a sideways reach to warm up the obliques and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.

3314.description: A ring hold with the arms out and the legs straddled. It builds the chest and shoulders and is a stepping stone toward the full maltese.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle position.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，悬挂在一对环上，双臂完全伸展，身体呈一条直线。
双腿分开，形成跨坐姿势。
启动你的核心并慢慢降低你的身体，直到你的手臂与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3378.description: Jumping lunges while waving the ropes, a demanding mix of power and cardio.
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching for the set time.

3442.description: An explosive overhead throw with a medicine ball, working the upper body and trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding the ball overhead.
Arch back slightly.
Throw the ball forward and down with force.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball.
Reset and repeat.

3506.description: A row done by holding both sides of a doorframe and leaning back. It trains the back and arms.
instructions: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.

3570.description: Roll a ball against a wall under the top of your shoulder to relieve tight upper trapezius muscles.
instructions: Stand with your back to a wall and place a ball on top of one shoulder.
Lean into the wall to press the ball into the muscle.
Move slowly by bending your knees.
Pause on tender spots and breathe.
Switch to the other shoulder.

3634.description: A wide seated stretch with arms overhead to open the hips, inner thighs and shoulders.
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back straight.
Raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward slowly from the hips.
Keep your arms extended and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then sit tall.

3698.description: An inchworm walk-out, walking the hands forward into a plank and the feet back in. It stretches the hamstrings and trains the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Keeping your legs straight, walk your feet towards your hands, bringing your hips up towards the ceiling.
Continue walking your hands forward, repeating the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
保持双腿伸直，将脚移向双手，将臀部抬向天花板。
继续向前移动双手，重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。

3826.description: Lying on your back, you sweep your arms in a big arc overhead. It opens up your shoulders and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise your arms to the ceiling.
Sweep them in a wide arc overhead toward the floor.
Continue the arc back down to your sides.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down.

3890.description: A hanging leg raise where the knees travel up to the elbows, working the abs and hip flexors hard.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Brace your core and tuck your knees.
Raise your knees up toward your elbows.
Curl your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the desired reps.

3954.description: Rotate from a front plank into a side plank to train the core.
instructions: Start in a front plank on your forearms or hands.
Rotate your body to one side, lifting one arm up.
Hold briefly in a side plank.
Return to the front plank.
Alternate sides.

4018.description: Lift your hips off the floor with your legs raised. It focuses on the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

4082.description: Standing side bend with a band stretched overhead, training the obliques.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends overhead.
Keep your core braced.
Bend sideways at your waist.
Return to upright.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

4146.description: A one arm band row where you rotate the torso as you pull. It trains the lats and back while the trunk resists and controls the twist.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand sideways to the anchor with feet shoulder width apart.
Row the handle toward your ribs while turning your torso gently toward the pulling side.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, untwisting as your arm extends.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

4210.description: A snatch where you drop into a split stance as the kettlebell goes overhead. It trains hip power, shoulder stability and coordination.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell in a hip hinge with a flat back.
Swing it back, then drive your hips forward.
As the bell rises, step into a split stance and punch it overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bell resting behind your wrist.
Stand up, bring your feet together and lower the bell to a swing.
Switch arms after your reps.

4338.description: A barbell curl done chest-down on an incline bench, which removes swinging and isolates the biceps.
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and a barbell in your hands.
Grip the bar with palms facing up, shoulder-width.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

4402.description: A wide-legged forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on your hips and lengthen your spine.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor or to your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise slowly.

4466.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the back of the knee (popliteal area). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your back of the knee (popliteal area) while sitting on the floor with your knee gently bent.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use very light pressure here and stop if you feel tingling.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4530.description: Pulling a kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder with one arm. It trains explosive hip power and coordination.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.

4594.description: A front push kick aimed at a partner's pad, training leg power, balance and timing.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad at body height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Raise your rear knee in front of you.
Extend your leg and push the ball of your foot into the pad.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Switch sides after your reps.

4658.description: A kneeling push-up followed by a quick shoulder tap with each hand. It builds the chest and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, then switch.
Keep your hips steady and repeat.

4722.description: A kneeling lean-back that isolates the quads with a deep stretch at the front of the thigh.
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and a support nearby.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward.
Lean back slowly as far as you can.
Pull back up with your quads.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.

4786.description: A side squat toward a bench with body weight only. It works the thighs and glutes one side at a time.
instructions: Stand sideways to a bench with feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

4850.description: A single-leg barbell hip hinge. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg.
Keep your standing knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower until your torso is near parallel.
Return and switch legs after your reps.

4914.description: A deadlift with dumbbells held with palms facing in. It trains the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and lower the weights.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Push through your heels to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Do not round your lower back.

4978.description: Kneeling ab rollout on gymnastic rings. The unstable rings make your core work hard to keep the body straight as you extend.
instructions: Kneel and hold the rings at about knee height with a firm grip.
Brace your abs and keep a straight line from head to knees.
Roll the rings forward by extending your arms until you are long but still in control.
Pull the rings back toward your knees by contracting your abs.
Do not let your lower back sag at any point.

5042.description: Lying face down, you pull the arms into a W shape. It builds the rear shoulders and mid back.
instructions: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your elbows and hands off the floor, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control.

5106.description: Lie on your back and tap each toe up toward the ceiling in turn. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised straight up.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Reach one leg up so your toes tap toward the ceiling.
Alternate legs with control.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.

5170.description: Small pulsing leg lifts from a kneeling position. It gives your glutes a burning, focused workout.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg back with the knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Pulse the foot upward in small, controlled movements.
Keep your hips square and your back flat.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

5234.description: Walk your feet up a wall into a handstand-like position, then walk back down. It builds shoulder strength and trunk control.
instructions: Lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Place your hands beside your chest and push up into a plank.
Walk your feet up the wall as your hands walk toward it.
Stop where you can keep your body straight and braced.
Walk back down slowly with control.

5298.description: A preacher curl with your torso turned slightly. The changed angle puts extra tension on the biceps.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Rotate your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

5554.description: A glute bridge with a dumbbell on your hips and the knees kept slightly forward. Keeps tension on the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.

5810.description: A kneeling glute kick back with the knee bent. It targets the glutes with a controlled squeeze.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.

5874.description: Face away from a high pulley and extend your arms overhead holding a straight bar. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up.
Return slowly.

5938.description: A seated twist with a diagonal chopping arm motion. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.

6002.description: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

6066.description: A triceps kickback done with both arms together using two bottles.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.

6194.description: A shrug holding kettlebells at your sides. It builds the upper traps and grip.
instructions: Stand holding kettlebells at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest tall and neck relaxed.

6514.description: A chest-supported row with palms facing each other, building your mid-back and lats.
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take a neutral grip on the handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

6770.description: A kneeling stretch for the long strap muscle across the front of the thigh and hip.
instructions: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward slightly.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

7154.description: A lateral shuffle where each step brings the knee high. It raises your heart rate and builds agility.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.

7282.description: Walking with a band around the legs to fire up the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Sit into a slight squat with feet hip width apart.
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the band go slack.
Walk back the other way to even it out.

7538.description: Floor slide that improves shoulder mobility and activates the upper back.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
Return slowly to the start.
Move within your comfortable range.

7922.description: A seated one-arm cable curl that keeps tension on the biceps. Good for fixing strength gaps between arms.
instructions: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.

8434.description: A seated roll-up that curls the spine forward one segment at a time. It trains the abs and spinal control.
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

8882.description: You wind a rope with a weight on it by turning a bar with a neutral grip. It builds forearm and grip endurance.
instructions: Hold the wrist roller with a neutral, thumbs-up grip and your arms out in front.
Let the weight hang from the rope with the rope unwound.
Roll the bar with your wrists to wind the rope up.
Keep your arms steady and your shoulders relaxed.
When the weight reaches the bar, lower it slowly by unwinding.
Stop if your forearms burn too much to keep control.

8946.description: Seated on a bench or floor, you lift one straight leg to train the hip flexors and thigh. It is a simple core and leg exercise.
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

9010.description: Crunching on a stability ball while holding a medicine ball adds range and load to the abs.
instructions: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause at the top.
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.

10674.description: A squat with a kettlebell held across your upper back. It loads the legs and challenges your trunk.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

10738.description: A box jump with a swing-through arm action. It builds explosive power and coordination.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.

10866.description: A one-arm machine row done from a bent-over stance. It targets the lats with a strong squeeze.
instructions: Set the machine and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle with one hand and let the arm reach forward.
Pull the elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

10930.description: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder outward. It strengthens the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Keep your elbow at 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Slide your hand outward along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

11058.description: A Romanian deadlift with your hips supported against a surface. It teaches a clean hip hinge and loads the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your hips lightly against the support, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

11250.description: A standing cable fly that trains your chest through a wide hugging arc. The constant cable tension keeps the muscle working.
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a staggered stance and lean slightly.
With soft elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest for a moment.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

11570.description: Standing, you extend one leg behind you against band tension to work the glutes.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or secure it low, and stand tall.
Hold a support for balance.
Keep your core tight.
Kick one leg straight back without arching the back.
Squeeze the glute at the end.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

11762.description: A chest-supported row on the Smith machine that takes stress off the lower back.
instructions: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

11954.description: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

12018.description: Passing a kettlebell around your torso in quick circles. It challenges the core, grip and coordination.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.

0050.description: A barbell raise on an incline bench that lifts the bar overhead. Trains the serratus anterior and shoulders.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell up to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Slowly raise the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住杠铃，杠铃间距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
慢慢地将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0114.description: Step up onto a box with the bar on your back. Works the glutes and quads, one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a barbell resting on your upper back.
Place one foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Push through your heel and step up onto the bench or step, fully extending your hip and knee.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat with the opposite leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在长凳或台阶前，将杠铃放在上背部。
将一只脚放在长凳或台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
穿过你的脚后跟，走上长凳或台阶，充分伸展你的臀部和膝盖。
在顶部短暂停顿，然后放低自己回到起始位置。
用另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

0178.description: Standing cable lateral raise: arms lift out to the sides against constant cable tension. It targets the side delts for broader shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your core engaged.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住电缆手柄。
保持双臂伸直，核心肌群参与。
将手臂向两侧举起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0242.description: A cable reverse crunch lying on a mat. You tuck the knees in and curl the hips up to work the lower abs.
instructions: Attach a cable to a low pulley and lie down on a mat facing up.
Hold the cable with both hands and extend your arms straight up above your chest.
Bend your knees and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
At the same time, curl your pelvis up towards your chest, lifting your hips off the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆连接到低滑轮上，然后面朝上躺在垫子上。
用双手握住电缆并将双臂伸直至胸部上方。
弯曲膝盖并抬起双腿，使膝盖靠近胸部。
同时，将骨盆向胸部弯曲，将臀部抬离地面。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低双腿和臀部回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0306.description: A dumbbell triceps extension on a decline bench. You lower the weights behind the head and extend to work the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbells slowly behind your head, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在斜凳上，头低于脚，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
将哑铃慢慢降低到脑后，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0370.description: A hammer curl with the upper arms braced on a preacher pad. The neutral grip hits the biceps and the muscles beside them.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂静止，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

0434.description: You hinge at the hips with nearly straight legs and lower dumbbells down your legs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your torso to lean forward.
Continue lowering the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，以臀部为铰链，将哑铃向地面降低，让躯干向前倾斜。
继续降低哑铃，直到感觉到腿筋拉伸，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0498.description: Hanging from straps with a straight body, you row your chest up. It trains the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set up a suspension trainer or straps at chest height.
Stand facing the anchor point and grab the handles with an overhand grip.
Walk your feet forward, leaning back until your body is at an angle.
Keep your body straight and engage your core.
Pull your chest towards the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在胸部高度设置悬挂训练器或带子。
面向锚点站立，并用正手握住手柄。
双脚向前走，向后倾斜，直到身体呈一定角度。
保持身体挺直并启动核心。
将胸部拉向手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0562.description: You hold a landmine barbell at chest height and rotate it in an arc from side to side. Works the obliques and core with strong hip drive.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and rotate your torso to the right, swinging the barbell down towards your right hip.
As you reach the bottom of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and rotate your torso to the left, swinging the barbell up and across your body towards your left shoulder.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住杠铃于胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖并将躯干向右旋转，将杠铃向下朝右臀部摆动。
当你到达动作的底部时，快速反向运动并向左旋转你的躯干，向上摆动杠铃并穿过你的身体朝向左肩。
继续这个扭转动作，两侧交替，达到所需的重复次数。

0690.description: Seated on a chair, you lean forward to stretch the lower back. Hold it gently and breathe slowly.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on your thighs or on the sides of the chair for support.
Slowly lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Feel the stretch in your lower back and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子边缘，双脚平放在地面上。
将双手放在大腿上或椅子两侧以获得支撑。
从臀部开始慢慢向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
感受下背部的拉伸并保持 20-30 秒。
慢慢回到起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

0754.description: On a decline bench, you press the smith machine bar with a reverse grip. Works the chest and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
反握抓住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其向胸部降低，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0818.description: A lat pulldown with two handles and a neutral parallel grip. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the cable machine.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit down and position your thighs under the thigh pads, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a neutral spine.
Pull the handles down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向电缆机。
正手握住手柄，双手与肩同宽。
坐下来，将大腿放在大腿垫下方，保持双脚平放在地板上。
稍微向后倾斜，挺胸，保持脊柱中立。
将手柄向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢松开手柄并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0882.description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or by your side.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Sit your hips back and lower under control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press up to stand, then switch legs.

0946.description: An arm balance where your knees rest on the backs of your upper arms and your feet lift. It builds wrist, arm and core strength.
instructions: Squat with feet together and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your shins against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands and lift one foot, then the other.
Round your upper back, draw your belly in and gaze slightly ahead.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your feet gently.
